description: This file defines the vardefs (variable definitions) for the 'jjwg_Maps' module in a SugarCRM / SuiteCRM extension. It specifies the database table, fields, relationships, and metadata for this custom module, including fields like distance, unit_type, module_type, parent relationships, and links to related modules such as Accounts, Contacts, Leads, etc.

classes.name: VardefManager
classes.description: A class responsible for creating variable definitions for SugarCRM modules.

methods.name: createVardef
methods.description: Static method used to create vardefs for a given module, specifying base types like 'basic', 'assignable', and 'security_groups'.
